name: Challenge rule gates and pet trial auras pass their server self-tests
contract: The rule self-test compared kill, battleground and disadvantage XP against the raw 1000 granted, but OnPlayerGiveXP applies the global XP rate (RATE_XP_GLOBAL) before the challenge hooks run, so the passing rules reported FAIL.
NO_REALM_BANK had no enforcement and was skipped as not applicable; it now has a gate and a self-test that also checks the personal bank stays open.
Trial auras spread to summons through OnCreatureAddWorld, but the reset only stripped creatures in the summon slots, so a free summon such as the pet test's 50075 kept the Nightmare aura 93132.
Expected: every rule gate passes, and the reset strips the trial aura from both player and summon.

steps.label: The realm bank rule is exercised, not skipped
The summary reports all rules passing
Run the pet trial aura test
The summon receives the trial aura
DISCRIMINATING: the reset strips the aura from player and summon
steps.text: aura stripped on reset -> player: PASS, summon: PASS
